about: Link rules of the web shell (docs/SHELL.md section 3), read by :data (LinkRules). ownHosts: top-level navigations to these hosts stay in the shell; any other http(s) host opens in the default browser. redirects: the site's outbound-link redirect page, unwrapped without being loaded. trackingParams: query parameters removed from every target that leaves the shell or comes out of a redirect. One reason per entry. Host evidence: request metadata of the owner's four recordings (docs/findings/payloads.md section 0), counted by host and type in docs/reports/M3a.md.

ownHosts.why: The site itself. Every main_frame of the four recordings was on m.facebook.com or www.facebook.com; its sockets (kaios-d., gateway., web-chat-e*.) and beacons are on other subdomains.
The site's own CDN: every image, video, script, font and stylesheet of the recordings (static.xx., scontent.*, z-m-static.xx., external.*). A photo or video opened on its own stays in the app.
The site's own sandbox domain: www.fbsbx.com was a sub_frame of the desktop page in session 183314 (and of the logged-out mobile page in M2a). Attachments are served from it.

redirects.why: The site's outbound link redirect (link shim): the target is the u parameter, h is a per-click hash. l. serves the desktop site, lm. the mobile site. Loading it would tell the site which link was clicked. Not in the recordings (no outbound link was opened); shape from the site's public behaviour.
